ChatTree bundles the SearXNG web search engine as a separate standalone binary
under tools/searxng. SearXNG is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public
License version 3 (AGPL-3.0).

- Project: https://github.com/searxng/searxng
- Bundled build & source (fork): https://github.com/dasdkslkd/searxng
- License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.txt

SearXNG runs as its own separate process and is never linked into or imported
by ChatTree code; the two programs communicate over HTTP.
